sources.title: Guinea Visa / ETA: electronic application
sources.publisher: Central Directorate of Border Police (DCPAF), Ministry of Security and Civil Protection
sources.officialityEvidence: The live PAF visitor service identifies the DCPAF authority and explicitly says online eVisa application does not itself grant a visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The online application of eVisa does not entitle the visa.

sources.publisher: Central Directorate of Border Police (DCPAF), Ministry of Security and Civil Protection

sources.title: Malawi e-Visa System: Visa on Arrival notice
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services, Government of Malawi
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Department portal’s current notice points to Category One and Category Two schedules and assigns the latter an arrival-visa outcome.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Category Two Countries are now eligible to obtain a Visa on Arrival at all designated ports.

sources.title: Category One Countries
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services, Government of Malawi
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official eVisa notice links this Department schedule, which names Burkina Faso, Cameroon and Sri Lanka in its advance-or-prior-authorisation category.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Countries and regions that require a visa well in advance, or prior authorization.

sources.title: Category Two Countries
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services, Government of Malawi
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official eVisa notice links this Department schedule, which also names Burkina Faso, Cameroon and Sri Lanka in its arrival-visa category.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Countries and regions that can obtain a visa on arrival with or without prior authorization.

sources.title: Do you need a visa to travel to Belize?
sources.publisher: Government of Belize Ministry of Immigration, Governance and Labour
sources.officialityEvidence: Belize Immigration’s live official nationality table gives Nauru the internally contradictory entry YES - NO and contains no Timor-Leste or South Sudan row.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official service provides generic electronic-visa workflow but no direct ordinary-passport result for Georgia, Eswatini or Afghanistan.
